fine_lines.title: active vs passive
fine_lines.explanation_ar: في الجملة المبنية للمعلوم (active) الفاعل يقوم بالفعل: Chefs make the sauce. في الجملة المبنية للمجهول (passive) يأتي الشيء الذي وقع عليه الفعل في أول الجملة: The sauce is made by chefs.
fine_lines.explanation_en: In an active sentence, the subject does the action: Chefs make the sauce. In a passive sentence, the subject receives the action: The sauce is made by chefs.

examples.sentence: Barbecue is loved by Professor Bot.

fine_lines.title: known as vs known for
fine_lines.explanation_ar: known as + اسم أو لقب (يُسمّى). known for + الشيء الذي يشتهر به.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Known as + a name or title. Known for + the thing that makes it famous.

grammar.title: Passive voice
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم المبني للمجهول عندما يكون الفعل أو الشيء أهم من الفاعل، أو عندما لا نعرف الفاعل. التكوين: فعل be (is/are/was/were) + التصريف الثالث. يمكن ذكر الفاعل بعد by. للمضارع المستمر: is being + التصريف الثالث (A battle is being held).
grammar.explanation_en: Use the passive when the action or the thing is more important than who did it, or when we don't know who did it. Form: be (is/are/was/were) + past participle. Add 'by' + doer if needed. Present continuous passive: is being + past participle.
examples: Anna was sent to cover a food festival.
A Barbecue Battle is being held in Washington, D.C.
Sauces are taken very seriously by chefs.
